The same applies to Long-Term Residents (to be checked). Other statuses allow different kinds of work; check with Immigration (to be checked).

summary.en: If your status is Student or Dependent, get "permission to engage in an activity other than that permitted by the status of residence" before you start work (to be checked). The general permission is, in principle, up to 28 hours a week, and not at places running adult-entertainment businesses (to be checked). The permission is written on your residence card. No fee (to be checked).

text.en: Show your residence card and submit the application form. Also bring your passport or certificate of status of residence. Other documents depend on your status and the type of permission.

text.en: For Student status, the general permission covers work of up to 28 hours a week (up to 8 hours a day during long school holidays). Activity at places running adult-entertainment businesses is not permitted (to be checked).

text.en: With more than one job, check that the total across all jobs is within 28 hours (to be checked).

text.en: For Dependent status, comprehensive permission is up to 28 hours a week. The long-vacation exception (8 hours a day) is only for students.

text.en: There is no application fee (to be checked).

text.en: Online filing is only possible together with an application to change, extend or acquire a status of residence.

許可された在留資格に応じた活動以外に、収入を伴う事業を運営する活動又は報酬を受ける活動を行おうとする場合には、あらかじめ資格外活動の許可を受けていなければなりません。
